t: An AI tutor and teaching assistant from the nonprofit Khan Academy.
steps: Go to the Khan Academy site and sign up for the free teacher tools.
Ask your district about a partnership.
Ask IT to review the district data privacy agreement.
Read the Common Sense assessment dated 2024-08-08.
Try the teacher tools for one lesson plan.
Check which third party language models the agreement names.
Pilot the tutor with one class.
